text:
Situation: Atenolol 25 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 105 tablets (6.4 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 80 tablets (25.1 days). Corvale General holds 321 tablets (23.8 days). All sites use Bryant Ranch Prepack product (NDC 71335-1535-1).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include atenolol as of 2026-10-21. Bryant Ranch Prepack's plant (FEI 1000519407) was last inspected on 2026-07-16 and classified VAI.

Our position: Internal supply is uneven. East is below a comfortable buffer. General and Lakeside have sufficient stock to support transfers without dropping below two weeks on hand. No national shortage is declared.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 35 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 127 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Evaluate purchase from Rising Pharma Holdings, Inc. — approved by buyer.
4. Evaluate purchase from ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. — approved by buyer.
5. Evaluate purchase from Actavis Pharma, Inc. — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No action that assumes a national shortage or alters clinical protocols.
